title: SLIs, SLOs & Error Budget Alerting
learningObjectives: Define Service Level Indicators (SLIs) for latency (p95, p99) and availability
Establish meaningful Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and calculate 30-day error budgets
Implement multi-window multi-burn-rate alerting to eliminate page fatigue
keyTradeoffs: Aggressive alerting sensitivity vs false alarm on-call engineer burnout
Freezing product feature deployments when error budgets are exhausted
commonPitfalls: Alerting on noisy CPU utilization thresholds rather than direct user-impacting error rates
Measuring mean latency instead of high-percentile latency (p99/p99.9)
transferPrompt: When SLO burn rate spikes due to an external API degradation, how does a circuit breaker protect your error budget?
